answer: Proof of Personhood using verifiable biometrics acts as a velvet barrier against illicit node multiplication. By requiring a unique pearl of cryptographic data tied to physical identity, the system forces attackers to bypass strict liveness tests. Each fraudulent identity pushes the malicious agent closer to the ledge of total banishment, as the cost of acquiring authentic human signatures scales linearly with the network size, making large-scale Sybil propagation economically non-viable.
